_comment: Curated Swiss duty overlays, applied automatically by build_duty_rates.py on EVERY build. The Passar master data carries per-code VAT rows (reduced/special rates surface as informational rows); this flat_taxes entry is the standard-rate headline reminder that import VAT applies on top of duty.

flat_taxes.name: VAT — Value Added Tax (standard rate, on the duty-inclusive value)
flat_taxes.applies_note: Standard rate; reduced (2.6%) and special rates apply to some goods — the per-code VAT rows below reflect the master data's own VAT assignment.
flat_taxes.legal_basis: Value Added Tax Act (MWSTG/LTVA), rates from 2024-01-01
